sentences.en: A prize was given in honor of the great scientist.
sentences.zh: 为了纪念这位伟大的科学家，颁发了一个奖项。

sentences.en: Kozue has never given way to despair in her life.
sentences.zh: 小泉一生从未向绝望屈服过。

sentences.en: Allen was given a problem that was impossible to solve.
sentences.zh: 艾伦被给了一个无法解决的问题。
